Monologue: Your restaurant gets busier and busier. I hope no one's been giving you trouble about the new policies.
In other news, our chief doctor we were searching for seems to have died. Or is gone. We're not sure, but he's not in the city anymore.
I don't think we needed that doctor. Svetka invented Essitol—I'm sure she'd know a thing or two about diseases.
Essitol? It's a drink the royals used when feasting, along with Aperia. Essitol to eat far more than normal, Aperia to vomit so they could start again.
My father adored the stuff. Overdosed on Essitol and died before I was born, they say. Svetka ran a lucrative business making drugs like that.
She could work on a cure herself if she wanted to. The rebels know that, the people know that—it makes being spoiled especially terrifying.
Svetka already had a plan in place to deal with the spoiled. That goes without saying. Now she has her excuse.
